title: CE60050: Analysis And Evaluation Of Mass
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Objective: The course provides an in-depth overview of the fundamental
principles of efficient operations, management, and planning of public
transportation systems. In particular, this course analyzes the capabilities
and limitations of transit systems; how to determine the optimal scale and
layout of a transit system; and how to practically implement the design and
operate such a system. Credit: (3-0-0) 3 CreditsSyllabus: Mass Transit System
Components, Theory of Urban Passenger Transport Modes, Evolution of Transport
system in a model urban area, Family of Transit Modes: Categories and
Descriptions; Performance Elements of Transit System, Fundamentals of Various
Capacities, Computation of Capacities, Capacity Constraints and Capacity
Improvement Strategies, Level of Service (LOS) definition, Different elements
of Transit LOS. Mass Transit Scheduling, Service Policies and Schedule
Development, Quality Management in Public Transport, Quality
Indicators.Faculty: Prof. Bhargab Maitra, Prof. Sudeshna MitraReferences:
"Transportation Engineering, An Introduction" by C.J. Khisty and B. K. Lall.
